thesis: The post-earnings gap has already repriced the good news: the stock sits well above SMA20 with RSI near 70, 3% off a 52-week high, and with reward/risk of only about 1.4 at high ATR. Trailing P/E near 98, net income down 86% y/y, and rising opex leave little room for error, with no scheduled catalyst to extend the move. Short interest near 28% of float cuts both ways, and a failed squeeze would retrace toward the gap base. The regime is neutral with tech and growth under pressure from a high 10-year yield, so a stretched high-beta name is a poor fit for selective, defensive-tilted exposure. A follow-on offering near highs after a 37% run is a live risk even though none is filed.
